title: Atmospheric brown carbon from biofuel pyrolysis: comparative analysis of dung and wood sources
content:

Diego Calderon-Arrieta, Jessica Knull, Shudeepta Sarker, JingKai Wang, Larissa Evans, Julius Ese, Seth M. Koloski, Abigail M. Smith, Nyiri Hajian, Kirby Hill, Baerbel Sinha, Alexander Laskin
Chemical and optical analyses of brown carbon (BrC) aerosol components indicate that dung-derived and wood-derived emissions are comprised of nitrogen-containing and oxygen-containing chromophores, respectively.
